units.source_text: 然而，这个计划也没有想像的那么顺利，在这里，夜晚比白天活泛。

en.t: However, this plan did not go as smoothly as he had imagined; here, the night was livelier than the day.

units.source_text: 隔着墙可以听到铁锹的声音……女人的呼吸……

en.t: Through the wall he could hear the sound of shovels... the woman's breathing...

units.source_text: 男人们搬动大网篮的叫声、咂嘴声……

en.t: The men's shouts as they moved the large net baskets, the clicking of their tongues...

units.source_text: 一下子都给风吸了进去，变成模糊含混的声音。

en.t: All at once they were sucked into the wind and turned into vague, indistinct sounds.

units.source_text: 三轮车的呻吟……远处狗在叫……

en.t: The groaning of a three-wheeled cart... a dog barking in the distance...

units.source_text: 越是努力想睡着，反而越是精神抖擞，兴奋得睡不着。

en.t: The harder he tried to fall asleep, the more alert he became, too excited to sleep.
